text:
evan: quick sync notes from today's mini design crit on the autoscale + capacity panel. Wanted to capture small copy changes, keyboard flows, and how we surface cost tradeoffs.
rhea: saw the prototype — overall looks good. Two immediate asks: make 'Min' label clearer and show a tiny worked example for non-engineers.
anya: agree. Proposal: label 'Min (reserved baseline)' and follow with muted example line: 'Example: min=1, burst=2 -> peak=3'. Use simple arrow instead of ->? monospace is fine.
ken: a11y: ensure the example is not only conveyed visually — it should be in the DOM as text for screen readers. Also slider handles need aria-labels with units.
marc: copy nit: swap 'Burst' to 'Burst capacity' across the panel to avoid confusion with pool names.
ev an: good call — consistent naming everywhere. Also, decision needed: do we show estimated cost change when user toggles burst on, or only after they click confirm? My preference: show an inline collapsed summary with a chevron so users see high-level change but can drill in.
rhea: inline collapsed is better for discoverability. But default collapsed to reduce noise. Include 'Estimated hourly change: +$X' in the collapsed view.
anya: UX for min/max validation: currently both fields highlight red when invalid. Suggest explicit inline error: 'Min must be less than or equal to Max. Quick fix: set Max to 2× Min' with a small button 'Apply quick fix'.
ken: keyboard focus order: make sure the 'Apply quick fix' is reachable via tab and that the action returns focus to the Max field after applying. Also announce updates to the Max field via aria-live.
marc: pool picker ordering: instead of alphabetical, default to 'Recommended' at top and include a reason: 'Recommended 80ms median latency in your region'. Small tag 'Recommended' helps new users.
ev an: good. When users switch pools, we should show a transient inline callout: 'Switching to pool X may change latency and cost. Preview changes' with a link to open the cost preview drawer.
rhea: mobile consideration: collapse helper copy under a 'Need help?' expander to avoid vertical overflow. Desktop shows it inline.
anya: SLO slider copy: change 'Target latency (p50)' to 'Target latency (median) (p50)'. Also add micro-copy below: 'Used to set fallback and burst thresholds'.
ken: color contrast: the slider thumb in dark theme fails at small sizes. We should increase contrast or add a 2px white outline so it meets AA. Also ensure focus ring is visible.
marc: canary UX: include default suggestion text 'Canary size: 5% (recommended)'. And micro-copy 'Auto rollback if errors spike > 2× baseline'.
ev an: guardrail feedback: instead of red outline for violations, use a warning pill with an icon and text like 'SLO below recommended floor  enabling burst suggested'. Keeps the layout stable.
rhea: love the pill approach. Also for finance clarity, change badge 'Guaranteed' to 'Reserved (billed)' and tooltip 'Reserved capacity is billed regardless of usage.' Be blunt.
anya: implement 'Auto-fix' flows for common mistakes: 'Set Max = 2× Min' and 'Set Min = 1 if you want steady warm workers' when min=0. Provide both suggestions but let user pick.
ken: accessibility checklist items: slider aria-labels with units, aria-live for numeric updates, menu roles for pool picker, keyboard order audit, and visible focus styles on all interactive elements. I'll run a quick axe pass once the prototype is ready.
marc: timeline: can we get updated Figma frames by Wednesday noon? Product review Friday.
ev an: aiming for Weds AM updates, clickable prototype by Thursday.
design-bot: Reminder scheduled: autoscale-ux-check @ 1794487200 (Thursday 10:00). React with :eyes: to RSVP.
rhea: I'll add final copy comments in Figma.
anya: will update the spec with the pill warnings and quick-fix actions.
ken: will do the a11y pass after prototype is published.
ev an: great work team — small iterations but they matter. Closing thread.
